cover.caption: Askeladden og Dukken i gresset. Hun er liten, men flink, hun!
cover.alt: En bitte liten jente i hvit kjole står blant smørblomster og prestekrager som er høye som trær. Over henne ligger Askeladden på magen i gresset og smiler ned til henne.
cover.prompt: A low, close view in a sunny early-summer meadow: the Tiny Grass Maiden stands among buttercups and daisies that tower over her like trees, holding out her skirt in a little curtsy with a bright smile. Right above her, Askeladden lies on his stomach in the grass with his chin on his hands and peers down at her, delighted, his long face dimpled with a big smile. Dew sparkles in the morning light.

Create the cover illustration for a children's picture book, in a square format. Do not write a title or any other text on it.

Picture: A low, close view in a sunny early-summer meadow: the Tiny Grass Maiden stands among buttercups and daisies that tower over her like trees, holding out her skirt in a little curtsy with a bright smile. Right above her, Askeladden lies on his stomach in the grass with his chin on his hands and peers down at her, delighted, his long face dimpled with a big smile. Dew sparkles in the morning light.

Characters in this picture (nobody else, unless the picture description mentions them):
- Askeladden: A tall, gangly young prince of about seventeen with long arms and legs, a long face with deep dimples when he smiles, warm hazel eyes, a straight nose and copper-red hair cut in a round bowl cut. He wears a sky-blue linen smock under a shiny steel breastplate that is a little too big for him, a brown leather belt, loose grey trousers and tall brown riding boots.
- the Tiny Grass Maiden: A doll-sized young woman of about seventeen, no taller than a doll, slim and light on her feet, with a small heart-shaped face, a tiny upturned nose, sparkling green eyes, rosy cheeks and a bright smile. Her straw-coloured hair hangs in two long pigtails tied with grass-green ribbons, with little daisies and buttercups tucked into it. She wears a simple ankle-length white linen dress with a narrow grass-green sash and tiny green slippers.

Story world: Old rural Norway in early summer, long ago. The king's castle is a large palace of dark logs with grass-covered turf roofs, carved dragon gables and a wide courtyard, among blooming meadows. In a meadow by the road stands the grassy tussock where the tiny maiden lives: a round, knee-high hump of grass and clover that opens like a little door. Inside is a snug, round room with walls of woven roots, a tiny chair, a tiny spinning wheel and a tiny loom. The tiny shirt is snow-white linen with perfect little stitches, no bigger than a man's palm. Her carriage is an ordinary shiny silver tablespoon pulled by two small white mice with reins of red thread. The big lake by the road is wide and still, with reeds and water lilies. Askeladden's horse is a sturdy dun fjord horse with a black-and-cream striped mane.

This story's season, light and colours: Early summer: meadows full of buttercups, cornflowers, clover and white daisies, fresh bright-green grass sparkling with dew, and clear morning light under a pale-blue sky with small white clouds. The lake is silver-blue and still. At the castle, a passing summer shower leaves puddles and everything glistening wet.

Cosy, safe and full of wonder. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not anime, no glossy digital look.

characters.name: Dukken i gresset
characters.description: En fin og vennlig jente, først ikke større enn en dukke, som syr en skjorte på én dag og blir like stor som Askeladden etter at hun faller i vannet.
characters.look: A doll-sized young woman of about seventeen, no taller than a doll, slim and light on her feet, with a small heart-shaped face, a tiny upturned nose, sparkling green eyes, rosy cheeks and a bright smile. Her straw-coloured hair hangs in two long pigtails tied with grass-green ribbons, with little daisies and buttercups tucked into it. She wears a simple ankle-length white linen dress with a narrow grass-green sash and tiny green slippers.

characters.name: Dukken i gresset (stor)
characters.description: Dukken i gresset etter at havmannen har hentet henne opp av vannet: nå like stor som Askeladden, og enda finere enn før.
characters.look: A full-sized young woman of about seventeen, slim and graceful, with a small heart-shaped face, a tiny upturned nose, sparkling green eyes, rosy cheeks and a bright smile. Her straw-coloured hair hangs in two long pigtails tied with grass-green ribbons, under a wreath of daisies and buttercups. She wears a finer ankle-length white linen dress embroidered with little green leaves and white flowers along the hem and sleeves, a grass-green sash and green slippers.

characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: Faren som setter prøven, men som kjenner igjen flinkhet og godhet når han ser det.
characters.look: A tall, thin, elderly king with narrow, sloping shoulders, a long, lined face, a long pointed nose, shrewd grey eyes under thin arched eyebrows and a neat, pointed grey goatee. He wears a tall, pointed golden crown, a long deep-blue robe with a wide border of rosemaling flowers in red, white and yellow, and pointed dark-blue shoes.

characters.name: Havmannen
characters.description: Et vennlig vesen med fiskehale som bærer Dukken i gresset opp av vannet. Da er hun ikke liten lenger.
characters.look: A big, friendly merman, a man from the waist up and a fish from the waist down, with a broad, weathered, kind face, a wide flat nose, twinkling sea-green eyes and a gentle smile. His long, wet, dark-green hair hangs to his waist with strands of pondweed in it, and he has a short, curly beard of the same green and a necklace of white river shells. His long tail is covered in shiny silver scales with a blue-green shimmer and ends in a wide, fan-shaped fin.

illustrations.anchor: «Hei», sa hun og rakte ut hånda.
illustrations.caption: «Hei», sier jenta fra tua. Hun er ikke større enn en dukke.
illustrations.alt: Askeladden sitter lei seg i gresset. Ut av en tue foran ham har det kommet en bitte liten jente i hvit kjole med blomster i håret, og hun rekker fram hånda.

A golden sunset beam slants in through the little door.
